name: Bedeguar Gall Causer
desc: Bedeguar Gall Causer (Diplolepis rosae): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 4 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Diplolepis rosae is a gall wasp which causes a gall known as the rose bedeguar gall, robin's pincushion, mossy rose gall, or simply moss gall.
